_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to cv/profile.json and replace every value with your own. Then run: python cv/build.py. Placeholder content is fictional and exists only to show the shape - none of it is claimable. Read cv/rules.md before writing real content.
_how_it_fits_together: A variant names the role ids and skill_group ids it wants; each bullet carries tags saying which variants it belongs to. build.py drops a role entirely if no bullet of its bullets carries the current variant's tag, so every role a variant lists needs at least one bullet tagged for it. All 8 variant keys below must exist - jobs/score.py picks among them by name, and a missing one breaks the daily scrape.
_choosing_your_variants: Variant keys are names you choose. jobs/settings.json maps each role family to one (a role's `cv`, plus its `cv_rules`), so every name used there must exist here - the shipped settings.example.json uses exactly these 8. Flesh out the ones you would really apply with and leave the rest as the one-line stubs below, or delete a variant and point its roles in settings.json at one you keep.
_worked_examples: The first two below are filled in to show every optional key in use. The remaining six are deliberately minimal - copy the shape of the first two into whichever ones you want, and delete the keys you do not need. Do NOT keep this file's wording; it is placeholder text, not a starting position.
_stubs: Minimal but valid, so nothing crashes before you get to them. Fill in the ones you want; a stub still builds, it just says nothing about you.
_annotation_keys: Keys starting with _ are notes for you and carry no meaning to the builder - delete them once you have read them. One exception: build.py iterates `variants` directly, so a _ key placed THERE is read as a variant and crashes the build. Keep variant notes inside a variant object, never beside one.

meta._note: {years} and {ai_tools} below are substituted into any variant summary that uses them. density scales line spacing; lower is tighter. Per-variant density overrides this one.

links._note: Keyed by id. A variant's `links` array lists the ids it shows, so a design CV can carry a portfolio that a QA CV leaves off.
